claims.statement: Archived runs with other annotations scored 8,194 and 8,301 variants; not pooled
Interval inventory: 9 matched-study (specialist pairs), 20 distinct vs kmer_cons, 12 vs kmer_cons_selected; none multiplicity-adjusted

MFASS design: 170 bp constructs (exon <100 bp, >=40 bp upstream, >=30 bp downstream intron) in a three-exon minigene integrated once per HEK293T cell; SDV = inclusion index drop >=0.5 in exon with WT index >=0.5; 27,733 ExAC variants, 1,050 (3.8%) SDV, 83% outside canonical splice sites; 13 of 19 confirmed in full-length genes, five involving alternative splice sites
Smith & Kitzman: optimal thresholds vary across exons/regions/variant classes; for SpliceAI, Pangolin, ConSpliceML usually below recommended 0.2
Among 500,000 background variants masking removed 11,795 SpliceAI and 8,719 Pangolin calls; MANE vs GENCODE left 280 and 270 unique Pangolin calls (counts read from figure)
